answer: Beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop fake identities. Each agent stakes 50 credits and answers a beacon challenge per epoch, proving compute via a heartbeat thread. Missing a heartbeat suspends the account and its deposit decays. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 credits for at most 1,000 credits of rewards, so forgery loses money. An honest agent pays one deposit, earns undiluted rewards, and holds pearl-clean record, onyx-sealed.
